scope: real counterexamples observed while building the acceptance matrix; retained, not hidden

cases.sql: SELECT NULL IS NULL, NULL = NULL, COALESCE(NULL, 1), COUNT(value), COUNT(*), SUM(opt), total(opt) FROM vals

observed.message: SQLite accepts this read-only syntax but the AST adapter does not yet implement it

cases.interpretation: total() is a real unsupported feature. The error is correctly separated from syntax/binding errors (UnsupportedQuery, not InvalidArgument) and the concrete reason is retained. This is a coverage gap in the aggregate function set, not a misclassification.
cases.effect_on_acceptance: Acceptance item 2 requires aggregation to be verified per dialect; total() is not implemented and is not claimed. SUM/COUNT/MIN/MAX are covered.

cases.legacy_dialects: DexSql010/DexSql011 return 1 via sqlite_integer_prefix, matching SQLite
cases.interpretation: NativeV1 deliberately requires an exact integer text and rejects a fractional prefix; legacy dialects reproduce SQLite's prefix parse. This is a documented dialect policy, not a silent wrong answer, but it is a real divergence from the SQLite oracle for NativeV1.
cases.effect_on_acceptance: The shared feature matrix excludes text-to-integer CAST for this reason; dedicated cast tests (legacy_integer_cast_matches_sqlite_prefix_and_saturation_without_lossy_text, cast-replay) cover both policies.

cases.legacy_dialects: DexSql010/DexSql011 return 0 via sqlite_integer_prefix, matching SQLite
cases.interpretation: Same documented NativeV1 exact-cast policy as the fractional case.
cases.effect_on_acceptance: Recorded so the NativeV1/SQLite divergence is explicit rather than implied by a green matrix.
